verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents team-scoped API keys, a team admin role that can revoke other members' keys, and adding or removing users to control machine access. That covers the core of credential governance. Nothing in the evidence shows a granular role model or any spend controls such as budgets or per-member limits, so the 'spend stays controlled' half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented role/permission tiers beyond team admin, finer-grained per-key scoping, spend limits or budget controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled

citations.quote: If you are a team admin, you can also revoke keys that belong to other team members.
Add or remove users to control who can access and administer your machine.
